citations.claim: cart position at first violating step shows cart runaway toward track end
mechanical energy at first violating step is highly elevated, consistent with saturated full-force driving
cart already far from center one step before violation, showing runaway trajectory

explanation: Coarse dt=0.02 with max sensor noise 0.02, light cart (0.5kg) and edge initial state (x=0.5,v=0.5,theta=0.1) causes state-feedback controller to saturate at force_limit=40 for the whole run (force=40 at steps 9-11). Saturated full-force acceleration drives cart to v~11.1 m/s and x~1.61m while pole whips from -0.51 rad (step 9) to -0.69 rad (step 10) to -0.887 rad (step 11), exceeding 0.8 rad pole_upright limit. Likely cause: fixed-gain/noisy feedback + actuator saturation + large integration step cannot stabilize this corner of the envelope.
vision_note: In frames 8 to 10 the cart moves steadily rightward while the pole leans increasingly far to the left. In frame 11 the pole has toppled sharply leftward and turns red as the violating body while the cart sits near the right wall.
